name: Sticky notes
what: Handwritten sticky notes slap onto a board one after another, a little crooked, each with a squash; they flutter in a draft, then peel off and fly away - a to-do list, reminders, tips.

learned_from.what: yellow notes slapping on one by one with handwriting
coloured notes popping on and peeling off

motion: a note every 12 f: from above 9 f + a squash 6 f, the words 4 f later; a draft lifts them; peel and away 3 f apart
